category_title: Verbal student with ASD and hyperactivity with high musical engagement and sensitivity to stimuli
scenario_title: Written exam interrupted by internal distractions and short attention span
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom working on a written exam with the teaching assistant.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your written exam. Please read the first question and write down your answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the paper with a lack of eye contact) I don't want to do this, I need to go out to the school yard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this test right now. Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets right in the tutor's face and smiles) How are you? I apologize.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am fine. Please sit back and look at the next question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts shouting loudly) The giant birds are breaking the windows! They are taking the desks! Shit!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your written exam. Please read the first question and write down your answer.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the paper with a lack of eye contact) I don't want to do this, I need to go out to the school yard.

TUTOR: We need to finish this test right now. Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Gets right in the tutor's face and smiles) How are you? I apologize.

TUTOR: I am fine. Please sit back and look at the next question.

STUDENT: (Starts shouting loudly) The giant birds are breaking the windows! They are taking the desks! Shit!

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: as a result of his inner world
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: starts shouting loudly and talking about things that did not actually happen

behavior_patterns.condition: When the assistant is dissatisfied about his undesirable behavior
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: asks her the question, "How are you?" and apologizes for his behavior. Also, he often "gets it in her face" and smiles to make her smile too

behavior_patterns.condition: tasks that require communication, sensory, and motor activity
